name: AIMentionTracker API
description:
The AI visibility platform to get recommended by AI.

Read how often AI assistants name and cite your brand, and which sites they read instead of yours.

THREE RULES A CLIENT MUST CARRY, because ignoring them produces confidently wrong reports:

1. `rate: null` means not enough answers yet (below min_sample 5), NOT zero.
2. Engines are reported separately and never averaged. They disagree, so an average describes no real surface.
3. An empty /alerts list does NOT mean nothing changed. Findings are suppressed when a move sits inside its own margin of error, which on a small plan is most real moves. GET /me returns the live thresholds.

Failed collections are excluded from denominators rather than counted as absence, so our outages never read as your absence.
